entities.summary: Kamena Vourla is a town and a municipality in Phthiotis, Greece. At the 2011 local government reform it became part of the municipality Molos-Agios Konstantinos, which was renamed to Kamena Vourla in July 2018. The population of the town proper was 2,796 at the 2011 census.
